title: OffMenu basket normalisation and integration research specification

canonical_units.geography: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 plus optional subnational code

metric_dictionary.label: Metabolisable energy
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preserve source calculation method; do not mix gross and metabolizable energy.

metric_dictionary.label: Metabolisable energy
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ; identify converted versus reported values.

metric_dictionary.label: Protein
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain nitrogen-to-protein factor or analytical method; grams do not measure digestibility or protein quality.

metric_dictionary.label: Total fat
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain method; total lipid and fatty-acid sums are not interchangeable.

metric_dictionary.label: Saturated fatty acids
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Subset of fat; do not add to total fat.

metric_dictionary.label: Monounsaturated fatty acids
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Subset of fat.

metric_dictionary.label: Polyunsaturated fatty acids
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Subset of fat.

metric_dictionary.label: Trans fatty acids
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain definition and analytical coverage.

metric_dictionary.label: Alpha-linolenic acid
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Keep distinct from EPA and DHA.

metric_dictionary.label: EPA
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: No conversion from generic total omega-3.

metric_dictionary.label: DHA
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: No conversion from generic total omega-3.

metric_dictionary.label: Available carbohydrate
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain component/expression; separate from carbohydrate by difference.

metric_dictionary.label: Carbohydrate by difference
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Includes or excludes fibre according to source; not automatically available carbohydrate.

metric_dictionary.label: Total sugars
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Not a proxy for added or free sugars.

metric_dictionary.label: Added sugars
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Requires explicit source or recipe definition; preserve jurisdiction.

metric_dictionary.label: Free sugars
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Requires compatible definition and ingredient evidence.

metric_dictionary.label: Dietary fibre
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain analytical method and fibre definition; different methods may not be comparable.

metric_dictionary.label: Water
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Needed to interpret mass density and dry-matter conversions.

metric_dictionary.label: Sodium
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preserve sodium separately from declared salt.

metric_dictionary.label: Salt equivalent
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Derived reporting convention: sodium_mg × 2.5 / 1000; not measured salt.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin C
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain ascorbic-acid-only versus total vitamin C definition and preparation state.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin A, RAE
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Do not equate with RE or IU; component data and conversion rules required.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin A, RE
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Separate series from RAE.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin D
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain D2/D3 and other included metabolite definitions.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin E
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Record alpha-tocopherol or alpha-TE explicitly; only aggregate compatible expressions.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin K
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Retain K1/K2/total coverage.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin B1 / thiamin
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preparation and retention method required.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin B2 / riboflavin
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preserve component definition.

metric_dictionary.label: Niacin
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Keep distinct from niacin equivalents.

metric_dictionary.label: Niacin equivalents
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Conversion requires component evidence and declared method.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin B6
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preserve component definition.

metric_dictionary.label: Vitamin B12
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preserve fortification and component definition.

metric_dictionary.label: Food folate
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Do not equate with folic acid or DFE.

metric_dictionary.label: Folic acid
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Separate fortificant amount.

metric_dictionary.label: Dietary folate equivalents
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Requires conversion convention and food/supplement context.

metric_dictionary.label: Calcium
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Content does not establish bioavailability.

metric_dictionary.label: Iron
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Content does not establish bioavailability; retain fortification.

metric_dictionary.label: Zinc
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Content does not establish bioavailability.

metric_dictionary.label: Iodine
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Do not infer concentration from iodized-salt wording alone.

metric_dictionary.label: Potassium
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Missing label declaration is not zero.

metric_dictionary.label: Magnesium
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preserve analytical or imputed basis.

metric_dictionary.label: Phosphorus
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Preserve analytical or imputed basis.

metric_dictionary.label: Selenium
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Origin and composition variability can be important.

metric_dictionary.label: Cholesterol
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Separate from total fat.

metric_dictionary.label: Alcohol
metric_dictionary.definition_rule: Record if present; not a default basket recommendation.

food_groups.label: Fruit, excluding juice
food_groups.rule: Separate fresh/frozen, canned and dried subtypes; no automatic fresh-equivalent conversion. Avocado is fruit under this proposed convention.

food_groups.label: Non-starchy vegetables
food_groups.rule: Culinary vegetables including tomato; green immature beans/peas included when identified. Excludes dry pulses, starchy roots and cooking plantains.

food_groups.label: Roots, tubers and other starchy staples
food_groups.rule: Potato, cassava, taro, yam, cooking banana, plantain, breadfruit and sago; not credited to headline non-starchy vegetables.

food_groups.label: Cereals and cereal foods
food_groups.rule: Rice, flour, bread, noodles, pseudocereals; wholegrain share requires ingredient evidence, not colour/name assumptions.

food_groups.label: Pulses and soy foods
food_groups.rule: Dry legumes and their identified products; no simultaneous vegetable credit.

food_groups.label: Nuts and seeds
food_groups.rule: Includes coconut under this analytical convention; species-specific allergen rules remain separate.

food_groups.label: Fish and seafood
food_groups.rule: Species, preservation and drained basis retained.

food_groups.label: Dairy
food_groups.rule: Keep plant alternatives distinct; fortification and fat level matter.

food_groups.label: Oils and fats
food_groups.rule: Group quantity is food mass, not chemically measured fat grams.

food_groups.label: Sweets, bakery and snacks
food_groups.rule: Recipe ingredients needed for any component group credit.

food_groups.label: Condiments and seasonings
food_groups.rule: Salt/sodium and allergen evidence remain product-specific.

food_groups.label: Beverages and beverage ingredients
food_groups.rule: Separate plain water, brewed drinks, dry tea/coffee and juice; do not use brewed values for dry quantities.

food_groups.label: Composite or prepared food
food_groups.rule: No fruit/vegetable group allocation until recipe/ingredient fractions are supported.

food_groups.label: Ambiguous or alternative choices
food_groups.rule: Resolve category, state or chosen alternative before nutrient matching.

food_concepts.canonical_label: raw sugar (described consumption examples, not recommended defaults)
labels: raw sugar (described consumption examples, not recommended defaults)

formulas.mass_coverage_for_nutrient: sum(edible_g with compatible nonmissing nutrient evidence) / total_edible_g; only when all mass known
formulas.energy_coverage_for_nutrient: sum(energy_kcal of lines with compatible nutrient evidence) / total_energy_kcal; only when all energy known

ranking_gate.basket_scope: complete declared basket; same evidence track and purpose
ranking_gate.estimates: Must be identified; modelled comparisons kept separate from measured comparisons. Sensitivity bounds must not reverse asserted order.
ranking_gate.partial_results: May display known totals and coverage; cannot represent full basket or receive default rank.

integration_status: Proposed entity and field contract only. No OffMenu codebase, endpoints, schema migrations, retailer inventory or credentialed API connections have been verified in this addendum.

basket_definition.minimum_fields: basket_id/version; ISO2/subregion; purpose/evidence track; household/period; source/rights
basket_definition.relationship: One basket → many separately versioned lines.

basket_line / food_concept.minimum_fields: line_id; original label; concept; original and edible quantities; state; substitutions
basket_line / food_concept.relationship: Generic concept is independent of a brand or barcode.

composition / observation.minimum_fields: composition_record/version; component; per-100-g basis; value/status; provenance
composition / observation.relationship: One record → many nutrient observations; retain field-level sources.

product_version.minimum_fields: product_id; GTIN; market; net/drained mass; formulation/label snapshot; ingredients
product_version.relationship: Product can match multiple generic concepts; GTIN alone is insufficient.

menu_item / recipe.minimum_fields: venue/outlet; item/version; modifiers; recipe/version; ingredients; yield; serving
menu_item / recipe.relationship: Menu item → selected recipe → ingredient/product quantities.

offer / supplier / site.minimum_fields: SKU; seller; outlet; market; currency/price/date; supplier/site IDs; availability
offer / supplier / site.relationship: Same product can have several offers and suppliers.

qualification / evidence.minimum_fields: subject; scheme/rule/version; issuer; scope; validity; status; proof; checked date
qualification / evidence.relationship: Claims attach to their actual product, site, entity, menu or lot.

comparison_result.minimum_fields: basket/version; metric; denominator; value/status; coverage; lineage; calculation version
comparison_result.relationship: Rebuild results when any relevant input changes.

qualification_aggregation.supported_share: sum(weight of pass subjects) / sum(weight of all applicable subjects)
qualification_aggregation.unknown_share: sum(weight of unknown subjects) / sum(weight of all applicable subjects)
qualification_aggregation.requirements: Specify denominator; complete weights; conflict shown separately; not_applicable excluded explicitly; unknown never silently counted as pass.
